fields.description: a corpse-pale pack hunter that follows the scent of fear and drags isolated prey underground.
a regenerating swamp brute covered in reeds, leeches, and stolen fishing hooks.
a dog-sized wingless dragon that spits burning resin and nests in chimneys.

traits: Burning Resin — A natural attack may ignite dry material; a creature hit by it takes 1 additional fire damage at the start of its next turn.

fields.description: a nearly invisible ambush predator whose brittle web cuts like wire.
an armored ghost that becomes solid whenever a nearby bell rings.

traits: Bellbound Form — Is incorporeal while no bell can be heard nearby and becomes solid until the end of its next turn when a bell rings.

fields.description: a floating lure of warm light attached to a huge subterranean mouth.

traits: False Beacon — +2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions made to lure a creature that mistakes its glow for a safe light.

fields.description: a rooted colony of skeletal arms that grabs creatures and plants their bones.

traits: Bone Grasp — A target hit by its grasp cannot move away until it succeeds on a {{ ability:strength.name }} action to escape.

fields.description: a white cavern beast that freezes moisture into decoy silhouettes.
a river monster that blinds boats with black mist before striking from below.

traits: Ink Cloud — Once per scene underwater, creates a 5-meter cloud that blinds other creatures until they leave it.

fields.description: an armored insect that rapidly corrodes metal and swarms the best-equipped target.

traits: Corrosive Bite — Natural attacks against metal objects or armor deal +2 damage.

fields.description: a translucent parasite that leaves sleeping victims awake but without memories.

traits: Memory Drain — After touching a helpless creature for one minute, erases its memory of the previous hour.

fields.description: a territorial plant-beast that launches barbed seeds into open wounds.

traits: Barbed Seeds — Can make a ranged natural attack; a damaged target suffers -1 to {{ ability:speed.name }} until the barb is removed.

fields.description: a thin humanoid able to move only through reflections and polished surfaces.

traits: Mirror Passage — Can enter one reflection and emerge from another visible reflection within 10 meters.

fields.description: a smoldering humanoid that collapses into choking ash when wounded, then reforms.
a six-legged reptile whose gaze petrifies only creatures standing in moonlight.

traits: Moonlit Petrification — A creature meeting its gaze while standing in moonlight cannot move until the end of its next turn.

fields.description: a tunnel predator that imitates several familiar voices at once.

traits: Familiar Voices — +2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions made to lure or confuse someone by imitating voices it has heard.

fields.description: a faceless fiend strengthened whenever someone nearby breaks a promise.

traits: Broken-Oath Feast — Gains +1 to all actions until the end of its next turn whenever someone nearby knowingly breaks a promise.

fields.description: a colossal bird nesting inside thunderclouds and hunting anything carrying metal.

traits: Stormborn — Takes no damage from ordinary lightning and can fly normally through strong wind.

fields.description: an ancient colony-creature disguised as an abandoned place of worship.

traits: Living Structure — While motionless, mundane inspection cannot distinguish it from the building or monument it imitates.

fields.description: a flickering predator that steals seconds from its prey to move impossibly fast.

traits: Stolen Seconds — After dealing damage, may immediately move up to half its normal movement speed.

fields.description: each severed head regrows wearing the face and memories of its killer.

traits: Many-Headed — Cannot be surprised while at least two heads remain conscious.

fields.description: a radiant undead figure offering miraculous healing that slowly replaces the recipient's will.

traits: False Miracle — Once per scene, restores 10% of a touched creature’s maximum HP; that creature suffers -1 to {{ ability:intelligence.name }} actions until it next rests.

fields.description: an enormous peaceful-looking shape whose shadow aggressively consumes living creatures.

traits: Living Shadow — Its shadow can make natural attacks against a target up to 5 meters from its body.

fields.description: a crystalline predator that falls from the sky and multiplies when exposed to magic.

traits: Magic Fission — The first time each scene it is affected by a spell, creates a fragile copy with 1 HP in an adjacent open space.

fields.description: A great incandescent bird reborn from a nearby hearth, carrying memories of those who fed the flame.
A hungry young giant imitates absent adults and turns every game into real danger.
A creature copies a person’s appearance but poorly understands their habits and bonds.

traits: Imperfect Mimicry — Can copy a humanoid appearance, but gains -2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions involving that person’s habits or relationships.

fields.description: A small demon offers trivial bargains whose wording hides disproportionate consequences.
A slow mass digests organic matter and soft metal, leaving objects it cannot understand.

traits: Corrosive Body — Deals 2 damage per turn to ordinary organic matter or soft metal it completely covers.

fields.description: A plant guardian walks far from its forest because its territory’s roots were poisoned.

traits: Rooted Stance — While touching natural ground, gains +2 to {{ ability:strength.name }} actions made to resist forced movement.

fields.description: An animated corpse continues a daily task without realizing the world has changed.
Armed bones repeat a military route and treat every breach of protocol as intrusion.
An ordinary beast bears an impossible adaptation caused by magical or alchemical pollution.
An artificial servant follows an order made dangerous by the absence of a master able to change it.
A possessed fowl displays absurd aggression, supernatural leaps, and resilience far beyond its size.
A colossal arthropod defends a nest built around a source of heat or magic.
A sculpture leaves its plinth to correct anyone contradicting the official event it depicts.
A slow creature secretes a substance that dissolves walls, armor, or memories according to its diet.

traits: Corrosive Trail — Leaves a trail that deals 1 damage per turn to one material chosen by its current diet.

fields.description: A supernatural reptile lives in fire and unintentionally spreads flames when frightened.
A winged predator imitates familiar calls to lure travelers onto dangerous ground.

traits: Familiar Voices — +2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions made to lure or confuse someone by imitating voices it has heard.

fields.description: An aquatic creature uses song and reflections to isolate a target from the group.

traits: Luring Song — +2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions made to isolate a listener that can hear the creature.

fields.description: A solitary giant guards a passage whose destination is forgotten but whose prohibition remains.

traits: Keen Sight — +2 to {{ ability:perception.name }} actions that rely on vision at long range.

fields.description: An immortal predator maintains a civil facade while scarcity makes control increasingly fragile.
A small creature feeds on recent memories and leaves victims unable to explain their presence.

traits: Memory Drain — After touching a helpless creature for one minute, erases its memory of the previous hour.

fields.description: A spirit reenacts an incomplete scene and turns violent when witnesses change its course.

traits: Haunting Loop — Repeats one scene; witnesses who deliberately interrupt it suffer -1 to {{ ability:intelligence.name }} actions until the spirit is appeased.

fields.description: Several incompatible anatomies struggle to control one artificially created body.

traits: Composite Instinct — Its mismatched anatomy supports this additional capability: {{ traits }}

fields.description: An animated natural force restores balance without understanding the lives in its path.
A stone sentinel changes buildings nightly and treats each new position as sacred.
A majestic predator protects its aerie and shiny objects mistaken for eggs.
A cursed creature petrifies from fear more than cruelty and collects statues of visitors.

traits: Petrifying Gaze — Once per scene, a visible target that meets its gaze cannot move until the end of its next turn.

fields.description: A transformed person leads hunters away from loved ones before losing control.
An ancient dignitary preserves a place, oath, or error that descendants would rather forget.
A creature endlessly alters its labyrinth and considers every lost traveler a willing intruder.

traits: Maze Sense — Always knows the shortest traversable route back to any place it visited within the last day.

fields.description: A subterranean predator follows vibration and heat, causing collapses and displaced ground.
A plant colony imitates scents, voices, and shapes to attract prey.

traits: Alluring Mimicry — +2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions made to lure prey by imitating familiar scents, sounds, or shapes.

fields.description: An immensely powerful creature guards a region-shaping secret more than material treasure.
A sea monster blocks a trade route and builds a nest from wrecks.
A gigantic creature periodically crosses communities built on its ancient route.
An entity bound to a specific injustice strikes the culprit’s symbols rather than true heirs.

traits: Symbol-Bound — Can sense and move directly toward any visible symbol of the injustice that binds it.

fields.description: An intelligent creature coordinates a colony and negotiates as if every individual were part of its body.

traits: Hive Mind — Can perceive through any allied insect within 100 meters and cannot be flanked by creatures they detect.

fields.description: A small reptilian humanoid that relies on traps, numbers, and narrow tunnels.
A hyena-headed humanoid that hunts in packs and favors isolated prey.
An animated corpse that advances relentlessly and follows simple orders.
A ravenous undead that stalks abandoned places in search of flesh.

traits: Paralyzing Claws — After a natural attack deals damage, the target loses 1 AP unless it resists the paralysis.

fields.description: An oversized scavenging rodent that nests in ruins, sewers, and refuse heaps.
A massive hunting spider that builds restraining webs across enclosed terrain.
A heavily armored desert arthropod with crushing pincers and a venomous tail.
A huge serpent that ambushes prey before wrapping it in powerful coils.
An enormous wolf that brings down large prey through speed and coordinated attacks.
A shapeshifting predator that imitates an ordinary object until prey comes close.

traits: Adhesive Hide — +2 to {{ ability:strength.name }} actions made to maintain a grapple against a creature touching it.

fields.description: A nearly transparent ooze that slowly fills passages and digests organic matter.

traits: Transparent Body — +2 to {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions made to remain unnoticed while motionless in dim light.

fields.description: A small winged reptile whose bite can briefly stiffen living flesh into stone.

traits: Petrifying Bite — Once per scene, a creature damaged by its bite cannot move until the end of its next turn unless it resists petrification.

fields.description: A winged leonine monster armed with claws, fangs, and volleys of tail spikes.

traits: Tail Spikes — Can make ordinary ranged natural attacks with its tail spikes.

fields.description: A two-legged flying reptile that hunts with a venomous tail and powerful jaws.
A two-headed giant whose independent attention makes it difficult to surprise.

traits: Two Heads — Cannot be surprised while both heads are conscious.

fields.description: A moving mass of roots, vines, and wet vegetation that seizes nearby creatures.
An undead spellcaster sustained by powerful necromancy and long preparation.
A supernatural hunting hound that exhales fire and pursues prey in coordinated packs.

traits: Flame Breath — Once per scene, can make one natural attack against every creature in a 3-meter cone.

fields.description: A large hidden predator whose continuous song makes listeners ignore it and rationalize the missing people it devours, even while abandoned rooms and extra possessions remain.

traits: Forgetting Song — Listeners unconsciously overlook the creature and people it has eaten; silence, deafness, an interrupted song, indirect observation, or overwhelming contradictory evidence can reveal it.

fields.description: A floating territorial aberration whose many eyes project different supernatural dangers while its dominant central gaze suppresses magic and RULE effects.

traits: Nulling Eye — Magic and RULE effects become dormant while the central eye is open and deliberately directed at them.

fields.description: A psychic predator that consumes memories, learned knowledge, reasoning, or fragments of personality while leaving the victim physically alive.
A stalking predator whose visible image continually appears a short distance from its true physical body.

traits: Offset Image — Attacks aimed only at its apparent position miss unless the attacker identifies the true body's location.

fields.description: A heavily armored subterranean predator that senses movement above, races through earth, and erupts beneath or beside its prey.
A crawling amorphous aggregate of mouths, eyes, and half-formed flesh whose overlapping voices disrupt coherent thought and speech nearby.

traits: Gibbering Chorus — Creatures that can hear it suffer -1 to actions requiring concentration or clear communication.

fields.description: A shapeless organism that absorbs memories and extrudes convincing imitations of people whose lives it has consumed.

traits: Borrowed Person — Can form a convincing physical imitation of someone whose memories it has absorbed, including habits and relationships known to that victim.

fields.description: A flat nocturnal predator that resembles a cloak, tapestry, hanging cloth, or patch of shadow until it unfolds and wraps around prey.
A malformed observer that perceives concealed guilt, personal secrets, and compromising facts, then bargains or threatens with what it learns.

traits: Secret Sight — After observing someone closely, learns one important fact that person is deliberately concealing.

fields.description: A supernatural warrior whose armor is the true persistent creature; destroying its wearer only gives the intact plate time to build or possess another body.

traits: Armor Rebirth — If the armor remains intact after the wearer falls, it can eventually reconstruct, create, or possess a new wearer.

fields.description: A small undead child-shape assembled from remains, abandoned toys, cloth, buttons, carved pieces, and household debris, able to steal and imitate familiar voices.

traits: Stolen Voice — Can perfectly reproduce a voice it has heard and temporarily leave that speaker unable to speak above a whisper.

fields.description: A colossal ancient serpent whose death curses the creature that actually delivered the killing blow.

traits: Slayer's Curse — When the serpent dies, the creature that dealt the final harm receives a lasting curse unique to this serpent.

fields.description: A creature assembled from discarded flesh, failed experiments, corpses, and organic refuse that can deform through narrow spaces and rebuild itself from fresh remains.

traits: Carrion Repair — Can incorporate fresh organic remains to replace a visibly destroyed portion of its body.

fields.description: A relentless supernatural hunter that returns after apparent destruction, changed so the exact method used against it before is less effective.

traits: Inevitable Return — Apparent destruction ends the current pursuit but cannot permanently kill it; each return bears evidence of the last defeat.

fields.description: A mobile coffin-like predator that drags a victim inside, closes around them, and tries to carry or bury itself with the captive trapped within.

traits: Self-Burial — While carrying a captive inside, can burrow through loose earth at half its normal movement speed without leaving a usable tunnel.

fields.description: An apparently ordinary pool or small body of water that is itself a creature, able to rise from its surface, seize prey, and drag victims into its depths.

traits: Water Body — Occupies its entire pool and cannot move away without carrying or abandoning most of its own substance.

fields.description: A supernatural social predator that feeds on resentment, humiliation, and bitterness by worsening disagreements and turning communities against themselves.

traits: Fed by Resentment — Gains +1 to social and supernatural actions while nearby people are actively escalating a grievance it encouraged.

fields.description: A creature whose limbs, wounds, organs, and internal structure become mutually incompatible when viewed from different angles.

traits: Perspective Anatomy — Changing viewpoint reveals a different arrangement of its body, so a wound or obstacle visible from one angle may not exist from another.

fields.description: A building-dwelling organism spread through walls, ceilings, and floors that manifests temporary mouths, limbs, tendrils, and eyes through architectural surfaces.

traits: Distributed Body — Moves through connected architecture and exposes only temporary pieces of itself; destroying one manifestation does not reveal the whole creature.

fields.description: A naturally soft creature that inhabits discarded skeletons, armor, mannequins, or other rigid frames to stand and move, abandoning each support when it fails.

traits: Borrowed Frame — Can enter an unattended rigid frame to imitate its shape and movement, then leave it behind without injury.
Unsupported Flesh — Without a frame, can squeeze through any opening large enough for its soft body but can barely stand or carry weight.
